fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $30,000 per location, paid as a lump sum upon signing the Franchise Agreement. Eligible Military (active, active reserve, or honorably discharged U.S. Armed Forces) may receive a 20% discount, reducing the fee to $24,000. The fee is non-refundable and fully earned upon receipt. Franchisor reserves the right to waive or reduce the fee for affiliates, subsidiaries, or other franchise candidates. A separate $2,500 Lease Review Fee (optional, if requested) and a $10,000 Grand Opening Marketing fee may also be due before opening.
raw_excerpt:
Upon signing a Thai Express Franchise Agreement ("Franchise Agreement"), you pay a lump sum Initial Franchise Fee of $30,000. You must sign a separate Franchise Agreement for each Thai Express Restaurant you operate and pay the applicable Initial Franchise Fee when the Franchise Agreement is signed. The Initial Franchise Fee is deemed fully earned by us upon receipt and is not refundable under any circumstances.

If you are currently an active or active reserve member of the U.S. Armed Forces or have been honorably discharged from the U.S. Armed Forces ("Eligible Military") you may receive a 20% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee.
